title: house-palette source
description: Schema for palette.json, the single source of truth. Roles are named for the job they do. A role is either a solid hex string, or an object carrying an explicit alpha, an alias to another role, or an alpha-only value with no colour of its own.

roles.description: Every role the artifact publishes. Both branches of a role hold the same schema so a role cannot change shape silently.
